sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF THE ARKLAMISS TO AL... ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF EASTERN NY AND NEW ENGLAND...

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT
sections.text: ON THE WESTERN FRINGES OF SUNDAY NIGHT/EARLY TODAY MCS ACTIVITY ACROSS KS/OK AND NORTH TX...A WESTERLY MID-LEVEL FLOW REGIME AND THE INFLUENCE OF DRIER ELEVATED TERRAIN WILL HELP TO QUICKLY REESTABLISH AN ELEVATED MIXED LAYER ALONG THE ROCKIES FRONT RANGE AND ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS. A COMBINATION OF THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS FRONTAL ZONE...RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES...MOIST/UPSLOPE LOW-LEVEL TRAJECTORIES...AND INFLUENCES OF HIGHER TERRAIN WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AT LEAST ISOLATED/WIDELY SCATTERED STRONG/SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT ESPECIALLY MID/LATE AFTERNOON AND BEYOND. INITIAL STORMS WILL LIKELY INCLUDE DISCRETE SUPERCELLS/SUSTAINED MULTICELLS WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT GENERALLY CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE INSTABILITY IN CONJUNCTION WITH 35-45 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR. SUCH DEVELOPMENT WILL BE LIKELY BE QUASI-FOCUSED ALONG THE FRONT RANGE/IMMEDIATELY ADJACENT HIGHER TERRAIN INCLUDING A CORRIDOR FROM EASTERN WY/WESTERN NEB PANHANDLE SOUTHWARD INTO EASTERN NM/ADJACENT WEST TX. LARGE HAIL WILL THE PRIMARY CONCERN...ALTHOUGH A TORNADO OR TWO MAY BE POSSIBLE...PERHAPS MOST PROBABLE IN AREAS SUCH AS WESTERN NEB/NORTHEAST CO/NORTHWEST KS LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING...WHERE DEEP LAYER/LOW-LEVEL SHEAR

sections.title: ARKLAMISS TO TN VALLEY/AL THROUGH EARLY EVENING
sections.text: A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN ADDED FOR PORTIONS OF THE REGION. AN MCV/CLOSELY ASSOCIATED BROADER SCALE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE...WITH WEAK HEIGHT FALLS NOTED ACROSS THE SOUTH-CENTRAL PLAINS/OZARKS THIS MORNING IN UPPER AIR ANALYSIS...IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE REGION TODAY. AHEAD OF THIS...AMPLE MOISTURE /LOWER TO MIDDLE 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/ AND RELATIVELY STEEP LAPSE RATES AND READILY EVIDENT POTENTIAL FOR MODERATE TO PERHAPS STRONG DESTABILIZATION NOTED WITH 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS SUCH AS SHREVEPORT/LAKE CHARLES LA TO JACKSON MS AND EVEN BIRMINGHAM AL. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR/LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE WILL REMAIN MODEST...INFLUENCE OF THE BACKGROUND MID-LEVEL IMPULSE AND SOME PERSISTENCE OF THE MCS/UPLIFT ALONG THE ASSOCIATED COLD POOL WILL LIKELY CONTRIBUTE TO SCATTERED MAINLY MULTICELLULAR CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF DOWNBURSTS/WIND DAMAGE ASIDE FROM SOME SEVERE HAIL. FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1105.

sections.title: NY INTO NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT UNDER THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERAL INFLUENCE OF AN EASTWARD MOVING SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER SOUTHERN QUEBEC. IN THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY STRONG WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT/DEEP LAYER SHEAR...SEMI-ORGANIZED BANDS/CLUSTERS OF STORMS SHOULD EVOLVE WITH POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS ASIDE FROM SOME SEVERE HAIL. FOR MORE SHORT-TERM DETAILS...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1106.

sections.title: GREAT LAKES
sections.text: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG A SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT THIS AFTERNOON AS DEEP ASCENT IS AUGMENTED BY A SERIES OF VORTICITY MAXIMA ROTATING AROUND THE QUEBEC UPPER LOW. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENTLY STRONG FOR ORGANIZED/ROTATING UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. THE PRIMARY FACTOR LIMITING A MORE ROBUST SEVERE WEATHER THREAT APPEARS TO BE THE MARGINAL AMOUNT OF INSTABILITY FORECAST. ..GUYER/SMITH.. 06/17/2013

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR PERSISTING THROUGH THE EVENING WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL DISCRETE SUPERCELLS FROM ERN CO/FAR WRN KS NWD INTO SERN WY AND THE NEB PANHANDLE. THE SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN EXPANDED A LITTLE NWD TO ACCOUNT FOR STORMS OVER EAST CENTRAL WY AND THE NRN EXTENT OF THE NEB PANHANDLE AND WRN NEB AS THEY TRACK SSEWD. ELY LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO VEER TO SLY AND STRENGTHEN TO 25-30 KT THIS EVENING...ENHANCING LOW LEVEL SHEAR FOR A CONTINUED THREAT FOR A TORNADO OR TWO. MODELS CONTINUE TO SUGGEST UPSCALE GROWTH IS POSSIBLE FOR ONE OR TWO TSTM CLUSTERS TO DEVELOP AND TRACK SWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS INTO THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD...WITH HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE PRIMARY THREATS LATER THIS EVENING AND TONIGHT.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STORMS THAT HAVE MOVED OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF ERN NM AND FAR W TX WILL CONTINUE TO EVOLVE INTO ONE OR TWO N-S ORIENTED BROKEN LINES AS INDICATED BY CURRENT TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY. A MOIST... MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS OVER MUCH OF WEST TX COMBINED WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR UP TO 40-45 KT WILL FAVOR SEVERE STORMS...SOME EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS IN THE LINES. ADDITIONAL ORGANIZED STORMS WILL PERSIST ALONG A NW-SE ORIENTED OUTFLOW ENHANCED BOUNDARY AS IT MOVES TOWARD THE PERMIAN BASIN. A DEEP WELL MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER EXISTS OVER THE PERMIAN BASIN WITH SURFACE DEWPOINT DEPRESSIONS UP TO 40 DEGREES...ENHANCING A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS. FOR THIS REASON AND THE POTENTIAL FOR A SWD MOVING MCS TO DEVELOP THIS EVENING OVER THE TX HIGH PLAINS INTO THE PERMIAN BASIN HAVE RESULTED IN A SWD SHIFT OF THE 30 PERCENT SEVERE WIND THREAT AREA.

sections.title: SRN LOWER MI INTO NERN OH/NWRN PA/WRN NY
sections.text: A FEW ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE YET THIS EVENING ACROSS THESE AREAS PRIOR TO THE STABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER.

sections.title: NORTH CENTRAL MT
sections.text: MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR UP TO 35 KT WILL SUPPORT A FEW ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS AS ACTIVITY MOVES OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTO NORTH CENTRAL MT. ..PETERS.. 06/18/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DESTABILIZATION WITH SURFACE HEATING WILL SUPPORT RENEWED STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES BY EARLY AFTERNOON...WITH POTENTIAL FOR A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS. A PORTION OF NRN LA...SE AR...AND CENTRAL MS WILL BE UPGRADED TO SLIGHT RISK IN THE 1630Z UPDATE...AND A SEVERE TSTM WATCH COULD BE NEEDED BY EARLY AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN OVERNIGHT MCS IS NOW WEAKENING ACROSS WRN AR AND NE TX...WITH THE LEADING EDGE OF THE PRECIPITATION DEMARCATED BY AN EXTENSIVE NE-SW ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. A SEPARATE/SMALLER CLUSTER OF STORMS ACROSS NRN MS HAS ALSO PRODUCED A WEAK OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ALONG ITS SRN-WRN FLANK. BETWEEN THESE BOUNDARIES...STRONG SURFACE HEATING IS UNDERWAY...AND REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS FROM SHV/JAN SHOW THE POTENTIAL FOR AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES AOA 3000 J/KG WITH LITTLE CONVECTIVE INHIBITION ONCE SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE 87-91 F RANGE. THUS...RENEWED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED ALONG THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES BY EARLY AFTERNOON...IN AN ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF STRONG UPDRAFTS/PRECIPITATION LOADING...AS WELL AS DOWNBURSTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING GUSTS. THOUGH THE CONVECTION WILL REMAIN MULTICELLULAR IN THE RELATIVELY WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR ENVIRONMENT...THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND AN UPSTREAM MCV IN OK WILL HELP PROVIDE SOME DEGREE OF ORGANIZATION TO THE CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON IN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR. THE COMBINATION OF WEAK-MODERATE INSTABILITY AND SUBSTANTIAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS WITH SOME RISK FOR DAMAGING GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. THE MAGNITUDE OF THE RISK AND THE NEED FOR A WATCH ARE STILL IN QUESTION...BUT A PORTION OF THIS AREA WILL BE UPGRADED TO SLIGHT RISK AT 1630Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS AN AREA OF DEVELOPING BOUNDARY LAYER CUMULUS ACROSS CENTRAL NY...SE OF THE A DIFFUSE SURFACE COLD FRONT INVOF THE SAINT LAWRENCE VALLEY. AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE UPPER 70S...MLCAPE WILL REACH 1000-1500 J/KG WITH SOME VERTICAL MIXING OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. EXPECT WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...AND STORMS WILL SPREAD EWD THROUGH THE EARLY-MID AFTERNOON. THIS AREA IS ALONG THE SRN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER MIDLEVEL WLYS...WHICH ARE CONTRIBUTING TO EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AOA 40 KT AND LONG STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS. THE NET RESULT SHOULD BE A FEW ORGANIZED/SUPERCELL TYPE STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS GIVEN THE STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THOUGH LAPSE RATES ALOFT ARE NOT PARTICULARLY STEEP...COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES AND POTENTIALLY MODERATE BUOYANCY COULD SUPPORT MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG/MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS BOTH CENTRAL/E CENTRAL WI...AND CENTRAL LOWER MI INTO THE THUMB. AT THIS TIME...THE HAIL/WIND RISK APPEARS TOO MARGINAL TO WARRANT A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS UNDERWAY ACROSS CENTRAL LOWER MI AND CENTRAL WI. STRONG SURFACE HEATING AND RESIDUAL BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 50S ARE SUPPORTING MLCAPE APPROACHING 1000 J/KG. ADDITIONALLY..THIS CORRIDOR IS BENEATH THE ZONE OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT...AND IN ADVANCE OF AN EMBEDDED SPEED MAX MOVING ESEWD OVER MN/WI. WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED IN THE WEAKLY FOCUSED LOW-LEVEL ENVIRONMENT...AND THE STRONGEST STORMS CLOUD PRODUCE MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND/OR STRONG OUTFLOW GUSTS GIVEN THE MODEST BUOYANCY AND SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED/SUPERCELL STORMS. HOWEVER...STORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN RATHER ISOLATED...AND THE MAGNITUDE OF THE HAIL/WIND RISK IS MARGINAL. THUS...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY...THOUGH THIS AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS ALONG THE E SLOPE OF THE LARAMIE RANGE...AND OTHER STORMS COULD FORM INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE. A SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL BE CONSIDERED NO LATER THAN 20-21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS THE EARLY STAGES OF DEEPENING CUMULUS/SMALL CBS ALONG THE LARAMIE RANGE IN SE WY...WITH OTHER BOUNDARY LAYER CUMULUS FARTHER E INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE. CONTINUED SURFACE HEATING IN AN UPSLOPE REGIME WITH DEWPOINTS MAINLY IN THE UPPER 40S WILL REMOVE CONVECTIVE INHIBITION AND CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON. THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 40 KT WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT AND RESULTANT CELL MERGERS COULD LEAD TO UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A CLUSTER OR TWO...WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DAMAGING OUTFLOW WINDS IN THE STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT. RELATIVELY LARGE TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS SHOULD LIMIT THE TORNADO RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING AND MOVE FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN EWD INTO THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. AN ATTENDANT LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WILL LIKELY ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER CORES. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE NEEDED OVER ERN NM AND THE TX S PLAINS BY 2000-2100Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 19Z SURFACE MESOANALYSIS PLACES A SE-NW ORIENTED DIFFUSE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM CNTRL TX INTO THE TX S PLAINS. THE AIRMASS S OF THIS BOUNDARY HAS BECOME RATHER UNSTABLE WITH 2300 J/KG MLCAPE PER MODIFIED 12Z MAF RAOB FOR THE 19Z SURFACE OBSERVATION. N OF THE BOUNDARY OVER THE TX PANHANDLE...AN EARLY MORNING MCS LEFT A RAIN-COOLED AIRMASS IN ITS WAKE. STRONG SURFACE HEATING IS ACTING TO DESTABILIZE THE SRN HIGH PLAINS WITH STORMS RECENTLY FORMING OVER THE SRN ROCKIES AND SWRN TX MTNS. ELY UPSLOPE FLOW HAS DRAWN A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER INTO ERN NM ABUTTING THE HIGHER TERRAIN. EXPECTING STORMS TO GRADUALLY MOVE EWD AWAY FROM SACRAMENTO AND SANGRE DE CRISTO MTNS AND INTENSIFY WITH TIME AS THE STORMS MOVE INTO GREATER POTENTIAL INSTABILITY. STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WILL SUPPORT A MIX OF ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES INCLUDING STRONG-SEVERE MULTICELLS AND SUPERCELLS. EVENTUAL CONSOLIDATION OF STORMS THROUGH THE MERGING OF COLD POOLS/OUTFLOW MAY LEND A TRANSITION TO MORE OF A WIND THREAT. THE MOST PROBABLE AREA OF STORM SUSTENANCE/EWD DEVELOPMENT THIS EVENING MAY BE ALONG/N OF THE WRN EXTENSION OF THE RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHERE PERHAPS A GREATER WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY MATERIALIZE DURING THE EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG THE FRONT RANGE...AND THESE STORMS WILL MOVE EWD ONTO THE HIGH PLAINS WITH AN ACCOMPANYING RISK FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS THIS AFTERNOON. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED BY 21Z...THOUGH SEVERE STORM COVERAGE MAY REMAIN A BIT SPARSE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG THE CO FRONT RANGE AS STRONG SURFACE HEATING CONTINUES IN A POST-FRONTAL UPSLOPE REGIME...WITH OTHER DEEPENING CUMULUS NEAR AND S OF AKO. SURFACE DEWPOINTS HAVE MIXED INTO THE 40S AS TEMPERATURES WARM WELL INTO THE 80S...RESULTING IN MODERATE INSTABILITY AND RELATIVELY HIGH LCL HEIGHTS. MEANWHILE...THE PUX VWP SHOWS SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS WITH WLY MIDLEVEL FLOW AOA 30 KT AND NEAR-SURFACE ELY FLOW OF 10-15 KT. THE SUSTAINED HIGH-BASED STORMS IN THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING AT LEAST ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON...WHILE THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL DEPEND MORE ON THE DEGREE OF STORM MERGERS...WHICH IS STILL IN QUESTION. A SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED BEFORE 21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BAND OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE TO THE ESE WITH AN ACCOMPANYING RISK FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER CELLULAR CONVECTION FROM CENTRAL/ERN NY INTO SRN VT HAS GROWN INTO A MORE SOLID BAND OF STORMS THROUGH CELL MERGERS. THOUGH THE STORMS APPEAR TO HAVE MOVED THROUGH THE ZONE OF GREATEST BUOYANCY IN THE PREVIOUS COUPLE OF HOURS...WARM SURFACE TEMPERATURES /UPPER 80S TO NEAR 90 F/ AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 50S ARE MAINTAINING MLCAPE CLOSE TO 1000 J/KG ACROSS INTERIOR SRN NEW ENGLAND AND SE NY. MIDLEVEL FLOW OVER THIS AREA AOA 50 KT IS ALSO CONTRIBUTING TO EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 45-50 KT...WHICH SUPPORTS ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS AND SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS...BEFORE DIURNALLY WEAKENING INSTABILITY AND CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING REDUCE THE THREAT. ..THOMPSON.. 06/17/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW SEVERE WIND GUSTS/LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY STORMS THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS AN AXIS OF DILATION/WEAK FRONTOGENESIS --ON WHICH STORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED-- FROM HASKELL COUNTY EWD TO WISE COUNTY TX. MODERATELY STRONG NWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW /25-30 KT/ ATOP A MOIST/MODERATELY BUOYANT BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT SOME STORM ORGANIZATION IN THE FORM OF A MULTICELLULAR MODE AS ISOLD STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON. MEAN FLOW FROM THE WNW WOULD ACT TO AT LEAST AID IN STORM MOVEMENT CLOSER TO THE DFW METROPLEX OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AN ADDITIONAL WEAK FRONT HAS BEEN NOTED MOVING SWD AND ARCING FROM 45 MI W SPS TO 30 MI SW GYI AND MAY ACT TO FOSTER ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT AND A FOCUS FOR LIFT. STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WOULD FAVOR AT LEAST SOME SEVERE WIND GUST/DAMAGE THREAT GIVEN PW AROUND 1.75 INCH /PER GPS DATA/. ISOLD BOUTS OF LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS BEFORE THIS ACTIVITY WEAKENS THIS EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS WILL MOVE OFF THE COAST OF SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...BRINGING THE THREAT FOR SEVERE STORMS SLOWLY TO AN END.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOPS SHOW A BAND OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS EXTENDING FROM JUST SOUTH OF BOS INTO SOUTHWEST CT. THESE STORMS ARE MOVING SOUTHEASTWARD AT 25 KT AND SHOULD BE OFFSHORE EVERYWHERE BUT CAPE COD BY 00Z. THE AIR MASS AHEAD OF THE STORMS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. A FEW ISOLATED CELLS REMAIN BEHIND THE MAIN LINE...BUT ARE IN A MUCH LESS UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT AND ARE NOT EXPECTED TO BE A THREAT FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS. ..HART.. 06/17/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DMGG WIND AND HAIL THREAT...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO...WILL CONTINUE TO ACCOMPANY TSTMS ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST TRENDS INDICATE TSTMS HAVE GENERALLY REMAINED ISOLATED/DISCRETE...WITH A COUPLE SUPERCELLS NOTED OVER CROWLEY AND KIT CARSON COUNTIES IN ERN CO AS OF 23Z. MODERATELY MOIST SELY INFLOW /E.G. DEW POINTS UPPER 40S-LOW 50S/ ALONG WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES OF 30-50 KTS SHOULD CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN TSTM INTENSITY FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT COUPLE HRS. DESPITE HIGH LCL/S...ENVIRONMENT ALSO REMAINS SUPPORTIVE FOR A BRIEF TORNADO WITH PERSISTENT RIGHT-MOVING SUPERCELLS...GIVEN FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES. ACROSS NRN PORTIONS OF THE WW...NUMEROUS OUTFLOW INTERACTIONS APPEAR TO BE OCCURRING ACROSS NERN CO/SERN WY...AND COULD RESULT IN SOME CONSOLIDATION INTO A SMALL LINE/BOWING SEGMENT IF CURRENT TRENDS CONTINUE. ..ROGERS.. 06/17/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST DMGG WIND AND LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL REMAIN FOCUSED OVER ERN NM AND THE TX S PLAINS THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. SVR THREAT CURRENTLY APPEARS MORE ISOLATED ACROSS THE NRN TX PANHANDLE...BUT SHOULD INCREASE AS TSTMS ENCOUNTER A PROGRESSIVELY MORE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: GREATEST COVERAGE OF STRONG-SVR TSTMS IS FOCUSED OVER ERN NM WITH A LOOSELY ORGANIZED BROKEN LINE EVOLVING OUT OF INITIAL UPSLOPE REGIME OVER THE HIGH PLAINS. ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED ALONG A BOUNDARY POSITIONED FROM APPROXIMATELY 30 S CVS TO 15 SE LBB AS OF 00Z. CONVECTION MOVING ACROSS ERN NM INTO W TX IS ENCOUNTERING A PROGRESSIVELY MORE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /60S DEW POINTS/ AND SHOULD CONTINUE TO SLOWLY ORGANIZE OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS...AND AN ACCOMPANYING THREAT FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL PERSISTING ACROSS THE TX S PLAINS AND PERMIAN BASIN. CURRENT TRENDS SUGGEST SVR THREAT COULD REMAIN MORE ISOLATED ACROSS THE NRN TX PANHANDLE. HOWEVER...WITH A MORE MOIST/UNSTABLE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT /AS NOTED IN 00Z AMA SOUNDING/...THREAT WILL PERSIST ACROSS THIS AREA...ESPECIALLY IF LINE CONTINUES TO EXPAND/FILL NWD INTO THE TX PANHANDLE. ..ROGERS.. 06/18/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DMGG WIND THREAT APPEARS TO BE GREATEST WITHIN A NARROW CORRIDOR AHEAD OF A SMALL BOWING SEGMENT APPROACHING W-CNTRL TX. SHOULD CONVECTIVE TRENDS PERSIST...WW 323 MAY NEED TO BE EXPANDED SLIGHTLY SWD AND EXTENDED IN TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR TRENDS SHOW SMALL BOWING SEGMENT EVOLVING OUT OF CONVECTION ACROSS BIG SPRING...WITH SEVERAL SVR WIND GUSTS REPORTED. ADDITIONAL CLUSTERS OF TSTMS HAVE BEEN ONGOING AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE...WITH AN ATTENDANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SLOWLY PUSHING SWD. IT IS UNCLEAR IF THIS CONVECTION DEVELOPING AHEAD OF THE BOWING SEGMENT WILL ADVERSELY AFFECT DMGG WIND POTENTIAL WITH THE AIR MASS BECOMING WORKED OVER. HOWEVER...IF CONVECTIVE TRENDS PERSIST...THEN PORTIONS OF WW 323 MAY NEED TO BE EXPANDED SLIGHTLY SWD...AND EXTENDED IN TIME THROUGH 05-06Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...BUT COVERAGE SHOULD NOT WARRANT A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPACT SHORTWAVE TROUGH CONTINUES TO DIVE SEWD ACROSS THE REGION WITH A POCKET OF COLD AIR ALOFT HELPING TO STEEPEN MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES. ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY IS MARGINAL ACROSS THE REGION...COLD AIR ALOFT COMBINED WITH INCREASING WINDS WITH HEIGHT WILL FAVOR A FEW CELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL. THE LACK OF LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL PRECLUDE ANY THREAT OF TORNADOES...ALTHOUGH SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH LONG HODOGRAPHS. IN ADDITION...DAMAGING WINDS ARE UNLIKELY GIVEN CELLULAR STORM MODE...AND HIGH RH BOUNDARY LAYER.
